INJECT_DEPOT_RESERVE.description: Dispatch reserve standby bus from closest depot immediately
INJECT_DEPOT_RESERVE.trigger: Predicted Demand-to-Capacity Ratio (DCR) >= 1.25 AND Passenger Deficit >= 400

SHORT_TURN_SHUTTLE.description: Turn back bus early to serve high-demand mid-corridor choke point
SHORT_TURN_SHUTTLE.trigger: Predicted Demand-to-Capacity Ratio (DCR) between 1.10 and 1.25 AND High Stop Boarding Concentration

REALLOCATE_SURPLUS_FLEET.description: Withdraw surplus bus from under-utilized route and shift to adjacent deficit line
REALLOCATE_SURPLUS_FLEET.trigger: Predicted Demand-to-Capacity Ratio (DCR) <= 0.40 AND Active Buses >= 4

DYNAMIC_PASSENGER_ADVISORY.description: Broadcast advisory on CUMTA app/digital displays to shift to parallel Suburban Rail / Metro
DYNAMIC_PASSENGER_ADVISORY.trigger: Corridor overlapping with Rail/Metro where Bus Demand-to-Capacity Ratio (DCR) >= 1.20

rail_metro_corridor_parallel.70V: Chennai Suburban Beach-Tambaram / Metro Blue Line
